New tile

Source: R/class_Tile.R
new_tile.Rd

Create a new tile object to store information for rendering a layer from a PMTiles archive file.

Usage

new_tile(source_layer, file, max_zoom)

Arguments

source_layer

`character` value with name of layer source in the archive file.

file

`character` value with file name for the archive file. Note that `file` must have a `".pmtiles"` file extension.

max_zoom

`integer` maximum zoom level for the archive.

Value

A `Tile` object.

See also

Other class: Dataset, Project, new_categorical_legend(), new_continuous_legend(), new_cost(), new_feature(), new_layer(), new_lock(), new_project(), new_provenance(), new_solution(), new_theme(), new_tileset()

Examples

# create object
x <- new_tile(source = "data-src", file = "file.pmtiles", max_zoom = 5)
#> Error in new_tile(source = "data-src", file = "file.pmtiles", max_zoom = 5): could not find function "new_tile"

# print object
print(x)
#> Error: object 'x' not found
